svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One beam: FRP 100 x 100 x 6 mm square tube, cut to 3,000 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a centre line on the front face. Positions are from the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blade bolt holes, 11 mm through both walls, front to back,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 110 mm above the floor line (50 above the beam's underside):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ten holes, 150 to 1,350 mm each side of the middle, 300 apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skid hanger holes, 11 mm through, at the middle and 1,200 each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 and 75 mm above the beam's underside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End cap holes: 13 mm top to bottom, 74 and 114 mm in from each end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use a sharp HSS or carbide drill, slow, backed with wood; wear a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: dust mask (glass fibre). Seal every cut end and hole with resin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the blade bolts with stainless crush sleeves inside the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the blade on the beam; all holes line up.
